verifiedImplementationFacts.contact: Name plus email OR phone; essential opaque session cookie; no native CRM lead is currently created.
verifiedImplementationFacts.ai: Dedicated configured agent, zero tools, bounded generation, structured validated output. Name/email/phone are not intentionally put into the generation input; visitor free text can still contain personal data.
verifiedImplementationFacts.humanSupport: Confirmed immutable packet; here-only operational channel; authenticated operator opens, claims and replies; no automatic outbound email or WhatsApp.
verifiedImplementationFacts.expiryAndDeletion: Logical expiry followed by hourly cleanup that clears encrypted sensitive fields before soft-delete. This is not proof of immediate physical deletion from backups or upstream provider records.
verifiedImplementationFacts.storage: Private state, receipts, support packets and staff credentials use fields marked encrypted in the dedicated Data Store collections.

marketInsightsProposal.requires: Owner-approved and published policy version/hash plus explicit server flag. Do not turn on collection merely because modules exist.
marketInsightsProposal.purpose: Understand completion of the site funnel and aggregate demand categories to prioritize product and content work.
marketInsightsProposal.data: Allowlisted contract event name, day, briefing version and enum taxonomy. Raw session/event identifiers are replaced by keyed opaque hashes. No conversation, prompt, concept text, contact details, IP, browser identifiers or credentials are accepted.
marketInsightsProposal.classification: Pseudonymized operational analytics, not a claim of irreversible anonymization.
marketInsightsProposal.access: Authenticated authorized site operator only; categories can be corrected with version checks. Aggregate outputs exclude subject identifiers.
marketInsightsProposal.deletion: Expiry and cleanup required for event and review records; retention must be applied to any approved backups as well.
